gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-alexandria: Capture It stands on a towering x-height, with strokes of unvarying width and letters that nearly seal shut. But Alexandria, a sans with wide terminals, lets text breathe, so paragraphs move along easily.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-devanagari: A towering x-height gives Capture It its urban punch, with letters drawn nearly shut. And Anek Devanagari, with distinctly open mouths, does the opposite job: the heading commands attention, the body carries the explaining.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, with a gaping c. Anek Gujarati opens up the page beneath Capture It, whose nearly sealed, towering letters supply all the urban command.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anek-malayalam: Capture It draws every line with one marker tip, towering and nearly sealed. Anek Malayalam, a sans with open curve tips, can be sized down modestly without losing clarity next to the heading.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-anuphan: Tall, tight and urban, Capture It towers over the text. Anuphan brings big round bowls and open curves, so the heading's nearly sealed letters get a generous foil beneath them.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-athiti: Tall, tough and nearly sealed, Capture It makes the first move. Athiti, cut like single-width vinyl with see-through s shapes, does the quieter work of carrying the words along.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-biryani: Capture It towers on a huge x-height, its letters nearly sealed. Biryani, with large-eyed e shapes and unmodulated lines, keeps every tiny counter unclogged, so text moves along smoothly.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-blinker: Blinker holds its line thickness steadily, with open apertures and lowercase that fills most of the height. Against Capture It's nearly sealed letters, that openness is the real standout.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-carrois-gothic: Carrois Gothic, a sans-serif with a high-set x-height and generous c openings, gives the text a bright, modern face. Paragraphs glide along beside Capture It's nearly sealed, towering letters.
gen-dafont-capture-it-gf-chocolate-class: Capture It towers on a huge x-height, drawn with compass-pencil consistency and letters that nearly seal shut. Chocolate Classical Sans can sit at a fairly generous size below the heading.
